subject: Request to keep pilot active while PO routes - StellarHealth
messages:
From: Emma Boyd <emma@stellarhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@stellarhealth.com
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Request to keep pilot active while PO routes

Hi Soojin,

Quick heads up — our procurement team has routed the PO for the pilot (PO #SH-9982) but there’s an internal review blocking final approval. Finance estimates another 6–8 business days before the funds are officially available. We’re right in the middle of a demo run and losing access will pause a proof of concept that demos model performance on our workflows.

Is there any way Redwood can keep the sandbox active for a short period while the PO clears? Even a small token top-up or a 7-day extension would let our engineers finish the evaluation and keep momentum.

I can provide the PO acknowledgement and the procurement contact if you need to reach out directly: procurement@stellarhealth.com.

Thanks — really appreciate any help to avoid a hard stop here.

—Emma Boyd
Director, Clinical Integrations
StellarHealth

Attachment: current_test_plan.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Emma Boyd <emma@stellarhealth.com>
Cc: procurement@stellarhealth.com
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to keep pilot active while PO routes

Emma — thanks for the quick note and for sending the PO acknowledgement. Totally get the urgency; losing the demo window would be painful.

I can provision a short-term buffer while procurement completes routing. I have two options we typically use:
- 72-hour token top-up (fast, manual approval)
- 7-day trial extension (requires one internal sign-off from finance and ops)

If your procurement team can confirm an estimated finalization date, I’ll propose the right option. If you want the fastest path, I can push a 72-hour top-up immediately and follow up for an extension if the PO is still in flight.

Quick ask: can you confirm the exact expected date the PO will be cleared? I’ll loop in our CS and finance contacts if we need internal approval.

Best,

Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

P.S. I’ve attached the pilot usage snapshot that shows where you left off — helps our ops team scope the top-up.

Attachment: pilot_usage_snapshot.png (image stub)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Request: approve 7-day extension or 72hr top-up for StellarHealth (DEAL-4721)

Hi Camila and Grace,

Thread below from StellarHealth — procurement has acknowledged the PO (SH-9982) but the final approval gate is expected to take up to 8 business days. Customer is mid-demo and will lose critical telemetry if we don’t keep the sandbox live.

Options I recommend:
1) Fast: manual 72-hour token top-up (~$125 of usage) — I can authorize now if Camila signs off.
2) Preferred: 7-day trial extension mapped to the same evaluated limits while PO clears (requires Grace/finance sign-off for accounting).

Why it matters: keeping momentum preserves product perception and materially increases conversion likelihood. Customer is already allocating integration work around Redwood; losing this week will push decision windows by a month.

Related info: HubSpot record https://hubspot.example/record/DEAL-4721; PO copy attached.

Can one of you confirm approval and I’ll execute? If you prefer, I can start with the 72-hour top-up and switch to the 7-day extension once finance confirms.

Thanks — Soojin

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 16:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to keep pilot active while PO routes

Emma — good news. Finance approved a 7-day trial extension for StellarHealth to keep the pilot environment live while SH finalizes the PO. We’ve applied a temporary access window that preserves your current rate limits and KV caching profile so integration tests can continue uninterrupted.

What we did:
- Granted 7 calendar days of continued sandbox access (effective immediately)
- Attached a short usage CSV so your engineering lead can validate token counts
- Logged the change to the HubSpot deal (DEAL-4721) and flagged for account team follow-up

If the PO clears earlier, please send the finalized PO or payment confirmation and we’ll reconcile the demo credits to zero out any temporary usage. If procurement needs us to talk to their accounts payable contact, we’re happy to help (Camila is copied).

Attachments: pilot_usage_report.csv (csv stub)

Best of luck wrapping up the integration — ping me if anything drops.
